Note that the costs may vary depending on the composition of the regimen being used. RR Cost over 9 months Country Patient Health System Total India $1152 $261 $1413 Philippines $2322 $702 $3024 South Africa $1026 $1926 $2952 Given the drugs included in the DCLLfxZ regimen, in particular delamanid, the cost would vary between moderate and large and may or may not be offset by the health systems costs for the longer regimen. For the drug prices, cost would be large from the NTP perspective. WHO consolidated guidelines on tuberculosis: Module 4: treatment and care 382
